## Primary paid result

US Macro Backdrop Brief — Treasury Rates, Debt & Labor
GET https://income2-treasury.onrender.com/macro-snapshot
Price: $0.025 USDC on Base

Use this for:
- daily market brief
- economic briefing
- rates backdrop
- fixed-income context
- pre-trade macro research
- Treasury + debt + labor research in one call

Result includes current Treasury yield curve/spreads, national debt and recent change, average Treasury borrowing rates, unemployment, labor-force participation, nonfarm payrolls and wages, with official-source timestamps/provenance.
